candidates.name: Coordinate tools and resources
verified_facts: OS distinguishes coordinate conversion from coordinate-reference transformation resources.
OS states that when transformation accuracy better than 3 metres is needed, OSTN15 and OSGM15 should be used instead of a simple spreadsheet transformation.
The Lite developer pack is a reduced-density approximation with lower accuracy, documented at about 0.08m horizontal RMS against the full version.
semantic_limits: A convenience or Lite transformation must not be treated as equivalent to the full OSTN15/OSGM15 model for high-accuracy parcel QA.

candidates.name: OS Net RINEX data
verified_facts: OS Net RINEX data is free to use and supplied in RINEX 3 format.
The product is updated hourly and provides hourly files at 30-second epoch rates.
It supports post-processed precision positioning and access to Great Britain's national coordinate reference system.
semantic_limits: Availability of RINEX observations does not by itself prove centimetre-level parcel height; observation duration, processing, antenna and datum errors remain separate.
